_doc: Object-level verification cases for the migrated corpus (corpus/mariadb/lms).
Each case runs on a freshly loaded database (00_compat .. 05_views).
'steps' run in order; 'expect' is compared with the rows of the LAST step.
'expect_error' / 'expect_message' must be raised by some step (Oracle: ORA-<n>; MariaDB: error <n>).
'expect_contains' passes if the text appears anywhere in the last step's rows.
Tokens: {TODAY}, {TODAY+n}, {DAYS_SINCE:yyyy-mm-dd}, {FINE_SINCE:yyyy-mm-dd} (= days * 5), resolved from the server's CURRENT_DATE.
Expected values are what Oracle returns for the same input (business rules in corpus/oracle/lms/03_plsql.sql).
